text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're in the quiet lull after a major race
when summer rolls around.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Time... off?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see now. This is all part of your plan for
my growth. In that case, I
will put my full
heart and soul into relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's just for a few days, and she's still got
class like normal, but I'm
hoping this'll give
her some extra time to have fun and
unwind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But then, the very next day, when I pass
the track on the way back to
my room...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Whew. That was a fruitful session.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah! Um, this is... How should I put it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. I understand that I'm
supposed to be relaxing, but I
just
couldn't bring myself to without practicing
first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Yaeno's directness is one of her best
traits, but this isn't the time for
it. She
needs a breather!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm sorry to have concerned you. I'm
embarrassed by the lack of
restraint I've
displayed...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I swear to use this mistake as a learning
experience. I'll get changed
and return to
the dorm at once. Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch as she heads away, but I can't help
but wonder if Yaeno really
understood the
part about not training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not here either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And... no Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given her reaction yesterday, I end up
doing a sweep of the various
training
facilities around campus, just to be sure
Yaeno's relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't see her, so she must've gone back
to her room after class, or
maybe she went
out with friends. Either way, she doesn't
appear to be
training, so I head out to get
some shopping done.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way home, I decide to swing by the
riverbank. It's kind of
become a special
place for me, what with the time we've
spent here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Hup! ...Hah! ...Sei! ...Tah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day I met Yaeno, she was here
training. I was completely awed by
her
beautiful martial forms as I watched,
frozen in place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice sounded so focused. Heh, I can
almost hear...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what a coincidence. Are you also out
for a walk?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I came off campus so I wouldn't be
tempted by any of the training
facilities,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I caught sight of this spot under the
bridge, nostalgia and
motivation
overwhelmed me... And I unthinkingly
disobeyed your
directions. I am terribly,
terribly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I don't know how to explain it, but it feels impossible to restrain myself from training. Whenever I laze around, I get this sense that I should be training...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks genuinely upset... I'm not
entirely sure if it's because she
wants to
train, feels guilty about not resting, or
both... But either
way—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
B-But you said that I need to spend time
resting to replenish my
strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...!
Osu! I'll continue where I left off, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, we exercise until sunset. It
seems like giving Yaeno breaks
isn't as
easy as I thought...
